title: Booking Workflow Field Guide
audience: Independent service businesses handling appointment requests manually
problem: Booking requests arrive through several channels and staff cannot reliably identify the next action or confirmation owner.
objective: Document one understandable intake-to-confirmation workflow with exception handling before implementing automation.
successCriterion: Five synthetic booking cases each produce a documented next step without duplicate confirmations.

evidence.label: Payhip payment notification documentation
evidence.relevance: Useful for distinguishing operational events from authenticated payment evidence; does not establish booking-product demand.

evidence.label: Payhip public integration scope
evidence.relevance: Useful for identifying integration limitations before promising customers a connected workflow; does not prove sales.
